run_downscale_images: run the python module to downscale all EXR images in a source directory to a destination directory
run_downscale_with_scale: run the python module to downscale images by a specified scale factor using parallel worker threads
run_downscale_to_jpg: run the python module to downscale EXR images and save them as high-quality JPEG files
run_downscale_custom_workers: run the python module to downscale images with a custom number of worker threads for parallel processing
run_downscale_in_place: run the python module to downscale images in place when the destination path matches the source path
